paragraphs: Netradyne sells AI-powered video safety and fleet management technology to organizations that operate vehicle fleets. Its Driver·i platform combines 360-degree AI cameras, real-time in-cab coaching, and positive driver recognition.

The company says it analyzes 100% of driving time, provides real-time alerts, and delivers safety insights meant to improve fleet performance. Instant in-cab alerts let drivers self-correct before incidents occur. Driver performance is summarized in a GreenZone Score the company ties to proving safety impact and retaining drivers. The same platform covers fleet tracking, fuel efficiency, preventative maintenance, and compliance. Driver·i is certified with the FMCSA as an electronic logging device, covering hours-of-service, DVIR, and IFTA requirements on one platform.

Fleets named on the site include Rumpke Waste & Recycling, where severe distracted driving alerts dropped more than 30% over twelve months. The site also reports that Knight-Swift adopted the fleet safety product, bringing in-cab coaching and full drive-time analysis to its trucking fleet. More than 25 billion miles have been analyzed, according to the company. It describes its mission as building intelligence for the physical world.
